book_title: No-code AI for Young Cambodian Learners
author: Rina Buoy, PhD
about:
A hands-on guide for secondary and high school learners (Grades 7-12) to build real AI without writing code, using Google Teachable Machine. It covers image, sound and pose classifiers and the ideas behind them: learning from examples, collecting varied data, training and tuning, testing with new data, and using AI responsibly.

This book was prepared with the assistance of Claude Code (an AI tool from Anthropic). The author provides the content and reviews and revises all of the outputs.

Plan: a complete reviewed edition by the end of 2026, with a free soft copy (PDF) and a low-cost hard copy.
